title: reservoir-slo-allocator-and-cross-region-venting
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: We observed repeated transient regional capacity spikes that caused SLO bleed-through even when global capacity was sufficient. Current load-shedding heuristics were too coarse: they triggered whole-route circuit trips or blunt token-level throttles, which caused poor user-perceived quality. This PR introduces a lightweight, low-risk mechanism called the 'reservoir SLO allocator' paired with a cross-region venting gate. The reservoir allocator maintains a short-term budget (reservoir) per route+customer that is continuously refilled proportional to the route's target SLO and recent success rate; requests are scored against the reservoir to decide permissive routing vs. soft-eviction. The cross-region venting gate allows controlled spillover to compatible regions with a staged penalty multiplier rather than an immediate failover. Summary of changes: 1) Core: added pkg/slo/reservoir_allocator.go implementing a lock-free reservoir token bucket with EWMA refill and adaptive windowing; provides a Score(request) API used by the routing layer. 2) Routing integration: routing/vent/gate.go wires the allocator into fast-path decisioning; we add a multi-tier response: allow, queue, soft-evict (best-effort reroute), hard-evict. 3) Cross-region venting: routing/vent/shipper.go implements staged spillover with configurable penalty multipliers and per-region backoff hysteresis to avoid oscillation. 4) Metrics/tracing: added slo.reservoir.{available,refill_rate,evict_count}, vent.spillover.{attempts,successes,penalty_applied} and trace spans for allocator decisions. 5) Config and rollout: feature flag runtime.enable_reservoir_allocator and per-tenant tuning knobs; default conservative values are used. 6) Tests and simulations: unit tests, property-based tests for allocator invariants, and a small load-simulation harness under infra/loadsim/ that shows improved SLO adherence in bursty scenarios. Backwards compatibility: the allocator is opt-in via feature flag and falls back to existing heuristics. Rollout plan: canary in eu-west-1 with 5% of production traffic for 48h, monitor slo.latency/p95 and slo.error_rate; then expand to us-west-2 at 25% for 24h before global rollout. Hotfix/rollback instructions: feature flag off immediately disables allocator; a short-circuit in routing returns to legacy path. Testing performed: - Local unit tests and property tests (CI) - Canary load sim on staging with synthetic spikes - Post-canary smoke run on internal perf cluster - Observability dashboards and PagerDuty runbook updated. Risks and mitigations: risk of excessive spillover causing capacity pressure in receiver regions — mitigated by per-region penalty multiplier and hysteresis plus a global spill cap. Risk of under-serving high-SLA tenants — mitigated by tenant-level overrides and an emergency bypass route. Related tickets and context: ENG-4312 defines the allocator design; ENG-4390 tracks the venting policy tuning; SUP-1184 was the customer incident that prompted this change. Merge notes: squash-merged after two approval reviews, small follow-up tweak to hysteresis constants applied in a post-approval commit.

review_conversation: Jonas Meyer: Nice design doc integration. Two suggested changes: (1) make refill EWMA alpha configurable via feature flag; (2) add an explanatory metric for 'eviction_reason' to help post-mortems.
Aisha Khan: Addressed both — exposed refill_alpha and added slo.reservoir.evict_reason tag. Updated tests and dashboards.

Li Wei: Observed a race in gate.go when region metadata updates; request to add a fast-path lock or use atomic snapshot. Also asked for additional integration test covering simultaneous region down/up.
Aisha Khan: Reworked gate.go to use atomic snapshot pattern and added integration test under routing/vent/shipper_test.go covering region flapping scenario.
Marta Rodriguez: Approved after verifying metrics and non-regression on internal perf cluster. Left note to monitor vent.spillover.successes during canary.
release_notes: Introduces an opt-in reservoir-based SLO allocator to enable finer-grained load-shedding and staged cross-region venting. Adds metrics and tuning knobs. Default feature-flag disabled; safe canary required.
